import datetime

print('current_year', current_year)
all_song_details=[]
for i,r in enumerate(all_recs):
    sid=r['song_id']
    d=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    all_song_details.append({**r, **{'release_date':d.get('release_date'), 'genre':d.get('genre')}})

# compute filters
rb_released=[d for d in all_song_details if (d.get('genre')=='R&B')]
print('count_RnB', len(rb_released))

def parse_year(x):
    if not x:
        return None
    try:
        # iso like 2022-11-08T06:55:52
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x.replace('Z','+00:00')).year
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            return int(str(x)[:4])
        except:
            return None

rb_released_this_year=[d for d in rb_released if parse_year(d.get('release_date'))==current_year]
print('count_RnB_this_year', len(rb_released_this_year))
print('rb_released_this_year_ids', [d['song_id'] for d in rb_released_this_year])
print('rb_released_this_year_titles', [(d['title'], d['release_date']) for d in rb_released_this_year])
# show all genres distribution

import datetime
from collections import Counter

# Ensure spotify token
if 'spotify_token' not in globals() or not spotify_token:
    spotify_pw=None
    for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if x.get('account_name')=='spotify':
            spotify_pw=x.get('password')
    login_res = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
    spotify_token = login_res.get('access_token')

current_year = datetime.datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Fetch all spotify recommendations (paginated)
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_recs=[]
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_recommendations', len(all_recs))

# For each recommended song, fetch genre + release_date

def parse_year(dt_str):
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    try:
        # handles 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS' optionally with Z
        s = dt_str.replace('Z','+00:00')
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s).year
    except Exception:
        try:
            return int(str(dt_str)[:4])
        except Exception:
            return None

rb_songs=[]
for r in all_recs:
    sid=r.get('song_id')
    d=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=d.get('genre')
    release_date=d.get('release_date')
    release_year=parse_year(release_date)
    if genre=='R&B':
        rb_songs.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': d.get('title') or r.get('title'),
            'release_date': release_date,
            'release_year': release_year
        })

rb_this_year=[s for s in rb_songs if s.get('release_year')==current_year]
print('R&B_count_total', len(rb_songs))
print('R&B_count_this_year', len(rb_this_year))
print('rb_this_year', [(s['song_id'], s['title'], s['release_date']) for s in rb_this_year])

target_song_ids=[s['song_id'] for s in rb_this_year]

# Find existing playlist titled exactly 'R&B Recommendation'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
playlist_matches=[]
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='R&B Recommendation', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for p in page:
        if p.get('title')=='R&B Recommendation':
            playlist_matches.append(p)
    page_index += 1

print('playlist_exact_matches_count', len(playlist_matches))
print('playlist_exact_matches', [(p.get('playlist_id'), p.get('title')) for p in playlist_matches])

if playlist_matches:
    playlist_id = playlist_matches[0].get('playlist_id')
    print('using_existing_playlist_id', playlist_id)
else:
    create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='R&B Recommendation', access_token=spotify_token)
    playlist_id = create_res.get('playlist_id')
    print('created_playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Add target songs
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
existing_song_ids=set([s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])])
print('existing_song_ids_count', len(existing_song_ids))

missing=[sid for sid in target_song_ids if sid not in existing_song_ids]
print('missing_count', len(missing))
print('missing_song_ids', missing)

for sid in missing:
    add_res=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('added', sid, 'res', add_res)

pl2=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
final_song_ids=set([s.get('id') for s in pl2.get('songs', [])])
missing_final=[sid for sid in target_song_ids if sid not in final_song_ids]
print('final_song_ids_count', len(final_song_ids))
print('missing_final', missing_final)

# Complete task
status_res = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print('complete_task_res', status_res)
